error[ZC-E0129]: the service has no rollout to pause or resume
  cause  service hello has no rollout in progress (the last one, to generation
         7, is complete)
  fix    see what the service runs   zcube rollout status hello
  more   zcube explain E0129 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0129.html
